description: Source code implementing classes and methods for constructing and managing rtnetlink messages in the quic namespace, including message creation, attribute appending, and message building functions.

classes.name: RtnetlinkMessage
classes.description: Class for constructing and managing rtnetlink messages, including adding attributes and building IO vectors.

classes.name: LinkMessage
classes.description: Class for creating link-related rtnetlink messages such as new, delete, and get link requests.

classes.name: AddressMessage
classes.description: Class for creating address-related rtnetlink messages such as new, delete, and get address requests.

classes.name: RouteMessage
classes.description: Class for creating route-related rtnetlink messages such as new, delete, and get route requests.

classes.name: RuleMessage
classes.description: Class for creating rule-related rtnetlink messages such as new, delete, and get rule requests.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::RtnetlinkMessage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a rtnetlink message with specified type, flags, sequence, pid, and payload header.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::~RtnetlinkMessage
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up allocated message buffers.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::AppendAttribute
methods.description: Method to append an attribute to the message with specified type and data.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::BuildIoVec
methods.description: Builds and returns an IO vector array representing the message.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::IoVecSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IO vector array.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::AdjustMessageLength
methods.description: Adjusts the message length by adding additional data length.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::MessageHeader
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the message header.

methods.name: LinkMessage::New
methods.description: Creates a new link message based on the specified operation, flags, sequence, pid, and interface info header.

methods.name: AddressMessage::New
methods.description: Creates a new address message based on the specified operation, flags, sequence, pid, and address info header.

methods.name: RouteMessage::New
methods.description: Creates a new route message based on the specified operation, flags, sequence, pid, and route message header.

methods.name: RuleMessage::New
